info.name: Prosthuti API — Admin, Web and Mobile
info.description: Prosthuti API organized into Admin, Web and Mobile. Authentication has five visible actions per client: Registration, Login, OTP Verification, Google Login / Registration and Logout. Session cookies and CSRF are handled internally; Google nonce preparation is in its request script. Sessions default to 30 idle days. Existing accounts are reused across OTP and verified Google sign-in. 136 request entries cover 59 route operations directly plus the CSRF and Google nonce helpers internally. The legacy explicit Google-link route remains on the backend for compatibility and is omitted from the simplified collection. Backend inventory now contains 62 operations. No live credentials are included. Student Web API integration remains separate.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Administrator authentication, profile, catalogue, content and media requests. Admin authorization is enforced on the server.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Passwordless authentication: Registration (email + name), Login (email), OTP Verification, Google Login / Registration and Logout. Cookie/CSRF handling is automatic. Session lifetime defaults to 30 idle days. Use an existing administrator account for Admin requests; signing up does not grant admin access.

request.description:
Starts passwordless registration with email and name (1–80 characters). Sends an OTP; creates no user until verification. The name is retained in the current session for this email. An existing account is reused without renaming it. Codes expire in 10 minutes; resend cooldown is 60 seconds.

Laravel route: `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request`.

Sends an email OTP using the same passwordless flow. Verification opens the existing account, including one originally created by Google. No password or manual token is needed.

Laravel route: `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request`.

Verifies the six-digit code and signs in. New users receive the name saved by Registration in this cookie session. Existing names, roles and progress remain unchanged. Session lifetime defaults to 30 idle days; logout invalidates it.

Laravel route: `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify`.

Device metadata is visible in Body > raw (JSON). Keep device_id stable per installation; Mobile platform can be android or ios. These values are metadata, not credentials.

exec: if (body.data?.id !== undefined && body.data?.id !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("user_id", String(body.data?.id));

request.description:
One action for Google sign-in or registration. With google_credential empty, the pre-request script prepares google_nonce/google_client_id internally and skips the login POST. Obtain a real Google Identity Services ID token using these values, put it in google_credential, and send again. Do not refresh the nonce after minting the token. Verified Gmail/Workspace email reuses the existing account automatically; new identities create a student. An unlinked non-Google-hosted email needs an OTP-authenticated matching session first. Linked identities remain identified by Google subject ID.

Laravel route: `POST /api/v1/auth/google`.

item.description: Student Mobile API requests using the same existing /api/v1 endpoints as Web. Persist session cookies and send CSRF for mutations; no separate mobile or bearer-token API is implemented.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Passwordless authentication: Registration (email + name), Login (email), OTP Verification, Google Login / Registration and Logout. Cookie/CSRF handling is automatic. Session lifetime defaults to 30 idle days. Use an existing administrator account for Admin requests; signing up does not grant admin access.

request.description:
Starts passwordless registration with email and name (1–80 characters). Sends an OTP; creates no user until verification. The name is retained in the current session for this email. An existing account is reused without renaming it. Codes expire in 10 minutes; resend cooldown is 60 seconds.

Laravel route: `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request`.

Sends an email OTP using the same passwordless flow. Verification opens the existing account, including one originally created by Google. No password or manual token is needed.

Laravel route: `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request`.

Verifies the six-digit code and signs in. New users receive the name saved by Registration in this cookie session. Existing names, roles and progress remain unchanged. Session lifetime defaults to 30 idle days; logout invalidates it.

Laravel route: `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify`.

request.description:
One action for Google sign-in or registration. With google_credential empty, the pre-request script prepares google_nonce/google_client_id internally and skips the login POST. Obtain a real Google Identity Services ID token using these values, put it in google_credential, and send again. Do not refresh the nonce after minting the token. Verified Gmail/Workspace email reuses the existing account automatically; new identities create a student. An unlinked non-Google-hosted email needs an OTP-authenticated matching session first. Linked identities remain identified by Google subject ID.

Laravel route: `POST /api/v1/auth/google`.

item.name: Practice and exam attempts
item.description: Create one attempt, save answers using snapshot item IDs, then submit. One active attempt per user. request_id is stable for retries; clear it before starting another attempt. See README for paper/chapter/affairs variants.

Optional subject_id/chapter_id/topic_id/exam_id/current_affair_id filters. mode=exam starts a server-timed mock. paper_id uses the whole published paper and forces exam mode. A chapter test requires mode=exam, chapter_id, chapter_test=true and completed lessons. Never regenerate request_id on a retry.
